caption:
U.S. agencies have issued a warning about attackers utilizing AI to develop exploits for industrial control systems, particularly targeting Siemens S7 programmable logic controllers. This shift drastically reduces the skill level and time required to launch attacks. ⚠️  

How can organizations better protect their industrial control systems?  

Sources: CISA, NSA, FBI, AI Safety Institute
